evidence.quote: | [New instance refresh features](#DocumentHistory) | You can now configure an instance refresh to set its status to failed and optionally roll back when it detects that a specified CloudWatch alarm has gone into the `ALARM` state. For more information, see [Undo changes with a rollback](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-refresh-rollback.html) in the *Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling User Guide*. | July 31, 2023 |

claim: Since July 31, 2023, an instance refresh can be set to fail and optionally roll back when a chosen CloudWatch alarm goes into the ALARM state.
